name: dynamization-core
title_zh: 动效与对比度都按物理量标定的界面语言包
tagline_zh: 动效不再靠手感瞎调，对比度不再分不清深浅色主题。每条规则都写成秒、像素、弹簧系数，让界面像真实物体一样有因果。
tagline_en: Stop tuning motion by feel and contrast by guesswork. Every rule is a physical quantity—seconds, pixels, spring.
desc_en: A runtime-agnostic language pack for interfaces that move and read like the physical world. Two pillars — motion (the language of time: causality, springs, asymmetry, orchestration, interruption) and luminance contrast (the language of space: elevation, focus, state, and why light and dark themes express depth by different mechanisms). Every rule is stated as a physical quantity — seconds, pixels,
why_zh: 它把时间与空间拆成两套独立语法：动效讲因果、弹簧、编排与打断；对比度讲 elevation。
why_en: It splits time and space into two independent grammars: motion handles causality, springs, orchestration, interruption; contrast.
limit_zh: 只提供语言规则与物理量标定，不含现成组件或代码生成器。需要你自行映射到具体设计系统；若你的产品全是静态页面。
limit_en: Rules and physical quantities only—no ready-made components or codegen. You must map them onto your own design system. Useless for static pages with.
title_en: A UI language pack where motion & contrast are physical.
